definitions.recall@5: Mean, over answerable questions that have retrieval hits, of how many expected (doc_id, page) pairs appear in the first 5 hits. Null when no question has retrieval. An empty hit list scores 0. Citations are not treated as retrieval.
definitions.citation accuracy: Fraction of answerable questions whose answer cites at least one page and every cited (doc_id, page) is in the expected set. A refusal or an empty citation list scores 0 for that question.
definitions.refusal correctness: Fraction of unanswerable questions returned as a contract refusal (kind refusal, reason not_found_in_manual).
definitions.uncited-number count: Sum of the active counter's count for each answer. The local counter counts digit tokens in answer text that do not appear in a citation snippet. It does not understand units or pinouts. The spec guard counter counts unit-numbers and pin references it would block. The results file names the counter.
definitions.latency p50 (ms): 50th percentile of per-question runner time in milliseconds. Linear index (n - 1) * 0.50.
definitions.latency p95 (ms): 95th percentile of per-question runner time in milliseconds. Linear index (n - 1) * 0.95.
definitions.correct-part rate: Fraction of golden questions whose part_id is a confirmed bay-map part and whose answer highlight names that same part_id. Questions with no part_id, or a part that has no confirmed region, are left out. A missing highlight scores 0.
definitions.region IoU: Mean intersection-over-union of each held-out hand label against the confirmed bay-map polygons the highlight renderer draws for that photo and part. A label whose pair is not confirmed is left out. Null when none resolve. Coordinates are the bay map's normalized plane, which the renderer scales to the photo. Rings must be convex. eval/hand_labels.json is used when that file exists; otherwise the synthetic fixture. This score does not depend on which golden questions ran.
definitions.unmapped-highlight count: Number of answer highlights whose part_id is not a confirmed bay-map part. Must be 0. python -m eval exits 1 when it is not.
